release: Pebble v1.5.0's frontend, frozen with capture/freeze-release.py and verified (tag commit 16dd425)
method: Pebble 1.5.0's companion (the frozen v1.5.0 tree) driven by scripted host events in v1.5.0's own event order (fidelity round 2): a re-enactment with sample data.

click.what: the pebble is clicked: the quick chat opens ('pebble.', 'A little help, right here.')

typing.what: the question types itself, one character every 34 ms (the person's part; the film may play it at up to 2x)

send.what: Enter: the question is sent; the status line says Sending, the task line 'Task: queued'

thinking.what: the status line says Thinking (the pose's status after the send; the run starts at 99, 'Task: running')

answer_token.what: the model's turn ends: its text arrives in one token event; the status line says Writing and the answer's article is added (its text renders on the next frame)

answer_visible.what: the whole answer shows at once: 'Python is being asked for a date that doesn't exist, like 31 February. If it's from your invoice export, open invoice-kit and I'll look.'

usage_line.what: the reply is saved: its usage line '1,180 in · 52 out · 3.3 s' shows under the answer

completed.what: the task completes ('Task: completed' for a moment); the header shows 'A little help, right here.' again

idle.what: the host's idle after its upkeep
